record.one_liner: The Podio API is a complete programmable interface providing OAuth2-authenticated access to all Podio functionality, including applications, items, and webhooks.

auth_methods.quote: The Podio API uses the OAuth2 protocol for authentication. This allows external apps to request authorization to Podio without having direct access to the user's password.

access_test.quote: 1 Get an API Key Get started right away - generate your API key .

access_ship.quote: 3 Go live! Share your project - get featured in our showcase .

api_type.quote: The Podio API is a complete programmable interface to all Podio functionality. We currently provide wrappers for PHP , .NET , Ruby , Java , Python , Android and Objective-C

api_breadth.quote: The Podio API is a complete programmable interface to all Podio functionality. In fact, the entire Podio frontend is built on the API, and we've exposed it all for you to use too.
